GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 123 (27 Dec 45) ESS/AC
(SCAPIN - 505)
APO 500
27 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Application of Nichiden Industrial Co., Ltd. to Exchange Shares
1. Reference is made to Central Liaison Office Memorandum No. LO 45, dated 6 December 1945, subject: "Dissolution of Holding Companies," which forwards application of the Nichiden Industrial Company, Limited, for permission to exchange shares of the Japan Electric Generation and Transmission Company for outstanding shares of the Nichiden Industrial Company.
2. The above application is denied.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
